apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **Release builds are signed with the release key and are not debuggable.** The head unit and the Android companion are
  built as release variants; `scripts/release/check_release_apk.py` fails the release unless each APK is signed with the
  pinned key and is not debuggable. The release job needs the four `RELEASE_*` secrets.
- **The head unit and the Android companion wipe their keys when the build changes.** A changed signing certificate or
  debuggable flag wipes the trusted keys (the settings stay). «Довірені пристрої» and «Підключення» say «Ключі видалено…»
  and the phones show «Ключ авто змінився…»; pairing again pins the new key. The HA card gets the same re-pair hint.
- **Settings export and import («Сховище → Перенесення налаштувань»).** The settings and the automations go to
  `BYD-Telemetry/settings.json` on a USB stick or flash card (the volume is picked when several are mounted). Passwords
  only with «Разом з паролями», which writes them in plain text. Import changes only the listed settings and reports
  what was skipped.
- **Updates from another signing key are not installed.** `update.json` carries `signer`; a newer build signed with
  another key shows «підписана іншим ключем, потрібне перевстановлення вручну» instead of installing, and the
  companion says the same. Reinstall is manual.
